title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README and workspace manifests to see that gritty-lots is a Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite pnpm monorepo.

title: Admin App Entry Point
description: The product boots in @gritty-lots/admin: main.ts creates the Vue app, App.vue mounts the shell, and the router wires file-based views.

title: Auto-Route Engine
description: The auto-route package scans views, reads routes.json metadata, and generates Vue Router records used by the admin app.

title: Shared UI Kit
description: Reusable presentational components, Tailwind styles, and composables live in @gritty-lots/ui and are consumed by the admin app.

title: Data Schema Kit
description: @gritty-lots/data-schema builds JSON-schema-driven forms and controls with AJV validation; the core Vue surface is the editor entry.

title: Page Neural Editor
description: page-neural is a Vue Flow visual editor that composes schema components into an editable page/flow graph.

title: File-Based Views
description: Admin pages under src/views are discovered by auto-route. The playground Vue page is a good example of a generated route target.

title: CI Deploy Pipeline
description: GitHub Actions builds and deploys the admin app when changes land on the default branch.
